Merlin partnerships and contracts

The full public-record table of Merlin partners and awards, plus short notes on the largest active vehicles. Ceiling dollars are vehicle ceilings unless stated as obligated.

Statuses as of 5 Oct 2026 Not investment advice

Highlights

C-130J SOCOM IDIQ

Sole-source IDIQ H9240824D0001 (“Automated Crew & Workload”), signed 7 Jun 2024. Ceiling $105M; ordering period through 6 Apr 2029 on the award record. About $15.96M obligated on the PDR/CDR order (H9240824F0010); that order’s period of performance ended 31 Jul 2026. Stages 3–7 were unfunded as of the 13 May 2026 prospectus. Remaining performance obligations at 30 Jun 2026 were $593 thousand. (USAspending IDIQ · PDR/CDR order · prospectus 13 May 2026 · 10-Q)

KC-135 + GE Aerospace

Merlin has described progress integrating on the KC-135 with the U.S. Air Force, and a 23 Sep 2025 joint release with GE Aerospace on an “autonomy core” collaboration naming the KC-135 Center Console Refresh as the first teaming opportunity. The prospectus says the teaming agreement runs 36 months and ends in 2028 unless extended. (GE/Merlin PR 23 Sep 2025 · prospectus)

SkyCourier UX with Textron

On 14 Sep 2026, Textron Aviation and Merlin introduced a Cessna SkyCourier UX concept at Air, Space & Cyber. Design objectives cited (~6,000 lb payload, up to three LD3 containers) are design objectives for a concept aircraft. Merlin 14 Sep 2026 · Merlin 18 Sep 2026

MDA SHIELD

Multi-award IDIQ with a $500 initial order; $151B is the shared vehicle ceiling (not Merlin-specific). IDV dated 3 Dec 2025. Active on paper. (USAspending)
